CustomField.description: TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036. Twinned from QuoteLineItem.ELV_Include_in_ARR_Calc__c (misleading name inherited from CPQ Exclude_ARR_Formula__c; TRUE means include). TRUE when the line is not excluded from ARR, has non-zero quantity, and is not a Summary Item.
